--- Page 5 --- Dedicated to my daughter Miss Abbabianchi Mrenda Momin --- Page 7 --- AGANSOCHENGANI A-gilsakni niksenggipa ku-sikrangchi sea-jotanirangko A-chikkuchi segiminrang baksa tosusaate nigenchimode banggija bilsirangonisa sena a hachengaha ine nikgen.
Da-alona dipet bang-gija ki-taprangkosan chapa ka-engpitti.
A-chikkuo bang'a dingtang dingtang miksonganirango, manderangni nangnikengggipa aro nichakenggipa seanirango ki-taprang dongchongmotna nangengaha.
An-chingna skang, English Missionary-rang aro A.chik pagitcham-ma gitchamrang an·chingna kasabee ki-taprangko see donangaha.
An'ching da'ororoni chadanberang uamangko mittelna nangchongmota.

A.chikkuo seanirangna ontisa changa-sapaniko on'gilpaengon ian tingtotsa chi gita ong'angpachina ine anga ia ki-tapko sece nienga indiba ki-taprangko bang'atnamangmang seaiode uarang jakkaltogipa ong'skajawachin; gisikna namgipa cha-aniko ongipa ki ldprangkosa an·chingna nanga.
Ki-tap segipa mande seng-begipa, uibegipa aro ki-tap seatangni ku-sikko jojrangpile ma-sigipa ong-chongmoina nanga; ian niam ine anga nikmanaha.
Unbaksana, Pa.
Hubert K Sangmani "Niksenggipa mikronrungna ugre sukgipinni nana gunko nikuu altuu ong ju" ingipa agananikoba gisik ra'ate, an'tango chu'onggijanirangko anga nikatmanengachim.
Indonga chanchianirangchi dongbokengon, golpoko porainan'gipa ripengrang iako ki-tapni himangona ra-bachina angna didianiko on-aha.
Viola Sonatchi B.
Sangma (Upper Chandmari, Tura) ia golpoko che-en che-em poraic nic gamchatbegipa namdapatanirangko dakaha aro ku'pattibeaha.
"Mangsunduk Tarigipu Paningsa" ia songadamni janggi tangbewalo pangchake segipa golpoko ki-tapni binango ong-katatna man'ahanina Nokgipa Isolko mittela.
Viola Sonatchi B.
Sangmani ku-pattian baksa namdapate Agandapaniko see on-ahanina, Directorate of Printing and Stationery-ni Assistant Director Pa.
E.D.R.Tariangni kusi ong.chakaniko separakahanina aro namhegipa cholko bikote print ka'atna dakchakahanina, Mendima Mondolini Pamong angni pagipa Pa.
Perkins K.
Sangmani aro angni jikgipa Ma.
Poppylinda M.
Mominni dontonggijan didiahanina, dingtang dingtang chol-ramarangchi ripengrangni dakchakahanina dingtangmancha man'gope anga iano nambegipa cholko ra-e mittelenga.
Ia kitap.

janggi tanganina tikkelenggipa sakantina, duk ba a'selrangko niksrapgija chagrongon Isolo ka-donge warachakchina aro Kristian sakantini mingnama gunrangko bikongkatchina didiatani aro ka-dongatani ong.china ine angni miksonge seani ong'a.
Unbaksana, saoba --- Page 8 --- indake separakna chanchie dongengode ian indakgipa manderangna chenge mesokaniong'a.
Ku-pattianirang baksa A-chikkuo katta jakkalanirangko aro bananrangko man'a dipet da'ororona krae donna jotton ka'aha.
agan-skie on-pachina poraisoenggipa sakantikon mol-mola.
Saniba baksa golpo aro bimung donanirang apsane dukniko ong-atode kema ka:pachina aro saoba ia golpoko poraie maiba namgniko man'pahaode uan angni duk chakani bite ong'china.
Shillong the 30h August 2008 WilberthD.Marak --- Page 9 --- AGANDAPANI 'Mangsunduk Tarigipa Paningsa' lan ku-akmao golpo seani bimang onga.
Ia ki-tapko segipa, Wilberth D.
Marak, kangalgipa tanggiparang maikai Kristian toromona ka-sinbee an-pilaha aro maikai dingtangggipa janggi tangbewalko chagrongahachim, iani gimin rongtale janapaha.

Songadamo mandeni songsaro janggi tangani bewal (cha-bewal, robewal..) aro uni ramramgipa bebe ra'anirang, uianirang, kenanirang aro uni songsul-noksulrang baksa duk suko bakrimanirang -uarangko janapanirangko nikna man'a.
Poraisoenggipani gisikko an-saoatna, obosta ong'anirango, agangrikao aro talatanirangko dakanio katta jakkalanirangchi ka-dingatani cholrangko jakkalaha.
larang baksana, pante-me-tra ka-sagrik-mikchagrikani obostarangkoba on-chapjolaha.

Indake ua mandeni salanti janggi tanganio ga'chate, uni miksonge parakatna skani, mande toromo kakket ong'e beberae tangode, neng begipa aro nangbemiting sal somoio dingtang dingtang tangani gadangoni salchroako man'e, chukalgipa kusi ong:gipa tangani gadang aro salrangna ka-dongsoani dongchongmota ine ong-a.
Wilberth D.
Marak, ia ki-tapna agreba bang-a golporangko ong:a.
Uni joton ka bee seani kamrang gipin manderangni gisikkoba sena-jotna gita didiani ongchina.

Bang-bata aro namnambata seanirang uni kolomoni ong-katdapkugen ine ka-dongsoani gnang aro ua, uarango chu-sokgipa ong'e, A-chikni sea-jotani a-bao ongilaniko dakangchina angni kakketgipa skanirang uni kamrango aro uni janggi tanganini chu-sokgnina ong-china.
V.S.B.Sangma Upper Chandmary, Tura.
--- Page 10 --- FOREWORD I happen to read the English translation of 'MANGSUNDUK TARIGIPA PANINGSA', a maiden attempt of folktale writer, Shri Wilberth D.
Marak, a young and promising short story writer in Garo, and found that through this folktale, the writer is trying to express his mind as if it is a real happening in life.
I am convinced that those who happen to read this folktale will definitely find it interesting and will capture them into the realm of folklore.
Dated Shillong.
E.D.R.Tariang September 24th,2008.
Asst.
Director Printing & Stationcry Meghalaya - Shillong.
